nodes.name: SCRUM-238 — timeout-recovery M5 slice

nodes.name: SCRUM-241 — unknown-write-reconciliation M5 slice
nodes.summary: Markdown document "SCRUM-241 — unknown-write-reconciliation M5 slice" (changelog entry, 8 lines): - Added deterministic unknown write reconciliation router. - Added provider readback requirement before retry or PASS. - Added no-blind-retry handling for unknown external effects. - Added duplicate-effect and replay-equivalence tests.

nodes.name: SCRUM-242 — cas-mismatch-recovery M5 slice
nodes.summary: Markdown document "SCRUM-242 — cas-mismatch-recovery M5 slice" (changelog entry, 8 lines): - Added deterministic CAS mismatch recovery router. - Added reload-before-retry behavior for newer checkpoint revisions. - Added no-overwrite/no-blind-retry guarantees. - Added concurrency and replay-equivalence tests.
